headline: SAFF's Female Daily page could not be read today (last 4.32); official Tokopedia proof is strong, with S.O.T.B at 4.9 from 18,246 ratings and the mini line at 4.9 from 18,550.
kpis_note: Awareness and NPS need a consumer survey; they are not measured from public web data.

insights.text: Female Daily today: Alchemist 4.43, Mykonos 4.27 and Onix 4.17 are flat vs the last reads. HMNS shows 4.15 vs 4.20 on 23 Nov, but its product pages still show Drops of Sunshine 4.7 and Philea 4.6, so the dip looks like a listing glitch. SAFF was not readable (last 4.32 on 27 Nov).
S.O.T.B makes up a third of SAFF's Female Daily reviews (4.1 from 586) but scores 4.9 from 18,246 Tokopedia ratings with about 0.5% at 1–2 stars.
Official-store proof keeps growing: the 5ml mini line has 4.9 from 18,550 ratings (0.3% at 1–2 stars), and Las Pozas and Coco each hold 4.9 from over 4,100.
Kirithra (4.9 from 439) gets a few blind-buy notes that it smells sharper or spicier than expected, plus one dented outer box.
Oily texture is a repeat caveat in long-form Lemon8 reviews (fabric marks), even when wear time (6–8+ hours) is praised.

recommendations.text: Confirm whether the 'saffnco.batam' Instagram account is an official partner; if not, report it and pin a list of official accounts and stores (Tokopedia, Blibli, Zalora) on the main profile.
Use product-level proof such as S.O.T.B 4.9 from 18,246 and minis 4.9 from 18,550 Tokopedia ratings in ads and product pages, not store-wide scores.
Add a 'spray on skin, not on fabric' tip to product pages and inserts to answer the oily-texture caveat.
For bold scents (S.O.T.B, Kirithra), add clear scent-strength notes and 'how much to spray' tips, and point blind buyers to the Rp79k mini first.
Run a quarterly survey (awareness, NPS) and upload a marketplace export to the Drive folder so low-star themes can be tracked.
